remarks: Introducing the epitome in luxury living,SIR Development's SIGNATURE Home in the most coveted neighborhood in Westport. Easy walking distance to Saugatuck's lively restaurants,downtown Westport,Saugatuck River access,Metro North & minutes to Longshore & Compo Beach.The inviting home is appointed w/ organic warm finishes & oak accents throughout.Custom vertical oak slatted foyer wall,10 ft ceilings& stunning windows spanning 2 floors invite you to explore the sun drenched open concept 1st floor, the perfect blend of modern living & entertaining.The Chef's kitchen includes Chic Taj Mahal natural stone countertops & waterfall edged island, high end Thermador appliances & walk-in pantry, opening to the spectacular Great Room w/ a handsome beamed oak ceiling & linear gas fireplace overlooking the heated, saltwater pool, terrace & private, professionally landscaped fenced back yard.The elegant formal DR is accentuated by custom built-in buffet & an exquisite ceiling w/ LED cove lighting.Rounding out the 1st fl is a stylish Powder Room, Office w/ built-in cabinetry & en-suite Bath that provides easy access to the back yard & pool.Upstairs find the luxurious Primary Suite w/ vaulted ceilings, linear gas fireplace, spa inspired bath w/radiant flr & walk-in closets; an en-suite Bdr and 2 addl Bdrs which share a Jack & Jill bath.There's a third floor bonus room, 5th Bdr & full bath.Finished LL features Media Room w/wet bar,Gym, 6th Bdr,Full Bath,Mudroom & Garage w/ EV charger,generator.
